newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Boulevard unit signs aircraft deal.
newsitem.headline: Boulevard unit signs aircraft deal.

text.p: The Philippines' Boulevard Properties Holdings Inc said on Monday its wholly-owned subsidiary Askar Ltd has entered into an aircraft purchase agreement with East West Capital of the U.S.

Boulevard president Abelardo Villacorta told the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) that the agreement included the assignment to East West of Askar's rights and obligations under a previous lease agreement involving a Boeing 737-200 aircraft.
Villacorta did not disclose the value of the transaction.
Boulevard officials said East West will now be the one to lease the aircraft to Grand International Airways, one of three local airlines plying international routes.
